about:
# FarmerNodes

A premium, performance-optimized resource node tracking addon for World of Warcraft (Forever / Classic Era / TBC Anniversary Edition). 

**FarmerNodes** automatically monitors, records, and displays coordinates for Mining Veins, Herb Bushes, Fishing Pools, Gas Clouds, and Treasure Chests on both the World Map and the Minimap.

---

## Key Features

### 1. Smart Node Collection & Tracking
* **Automatic Detection**: Intercepts spellcasts and gathers resource names from the game tooltip to accurately record harvest coordinates.
* **De-duplication & Distance Filtering**: Prevents database bloat by filtering out duplicate nodes within 15 yards.
* **Rare Spawn Integration**: Automatically removes coordinates of standard nodes (e.g., Fel Iron, Adamantite) when a rare spawn node (e.g., Khorium, Rich Adamantite) is harvested at the same position.
* **Floating Node Offsets**: Automatically projects coordinates 15 yards ahead of the player's facing direction for remote nodes (Fishing Pools and Gas Clouds) where players stand at a distance.
* **Zone Phasing**: Employs `HereBeDragons-2.0` to correctly map coordinates to the active WoW map ID, handling phased areas flawlessly.

### 2. High-Performance Display
* **World Map Canvas**: Built on Blizzard's modern `MapCanvasDataProviderMixin` architecture to render thousands of icons smoothly without frame rate drops.
* **Pooled Minimap Pins**: Minimap icons are dynamically cached and recycled to conserve memory. Pin positions automatically adjust to match your Minimap's zoom level, scaling, shape (circular/rectangular), and camera rotation.
* **Distance-based Transformation**: Minimap icon textures automatically transition into subtle, color-coded tracking rings when you enter their vicinity (default: 15 yards) for cleaner tracking.
* **TomTom Waypoints**: Right-click any World Map pin to add a TomTom navigation waypoint instantly.
* **Node Grouping (Clustering)**: Group nearby resource coordinates into clusters to minimize map clutter. On the World Map, hovering over a cluster center blooms out all the sub-nodes at their actual locations, connected by thin green lines, with a detailed list of every resource type in the cluster tooltip. Minimap clustering can be disabled independently (on by default) to preserve individual node visibility while gathering.
* **Adjustable World Map Opacity**: Customize the opacity and transparency of world map pins directly from the settings panel.

### 3. Settings & Controls
* **AceConfig Settings Panel**: Open using `/fn` or `/farmer` to configure pin opacity, scales, category displays, and database locks.
* **Customizable Minimap Colors**: Pick custom colors for the tracking circle indicators of each node category directly from the settings panel.
* **Minimap Circle Customization**: Set specific opacity levels for tracking circle indicators and enable smart opacity calculations to automatically dim indicators in crowded areas.
* **Flexible Display Modes**: Configure whether nodes are shown as their exact harvested resource, their most likely base resource (e.g. Fel Iron instead of Khorium), or their highest level potential resource.
* **LibDBIcon Minimap Button**: Includes a modern settings button featuring a custom fantasy compass icon. Fully compatible with minimap button managers (like MBB) to keep your UI clean.
* **In-UI Keybindings**: Easily assign hotkeys directly from the settings panel to quickly toggle Minimap and World Map icons on/off.

### 4. Database Maintenance & Import
* **GatherMate2 Migration**: Directly import your own harvested coordinates from local GatherMate2 SavedVariables.
* **Prefilled Data Importer**: Instantly load pre-existing community coordinates from the `GatherMate2_Data` library database.
* **Database Clean & Sweep**: Built-in de-duplication sweep engine to clean up close coordinates and optimize database search times.

---

## Installation

1. Download the latest release of **FarmerNodes**.
2. Extract the folder into your World of Warcraft directory:
   `World of Warcraft\_classic_beta_\Interface\AddOns\FarmerNodes` (Forever) or
   `World of Warcraft\_anniversary_\Interface\AddOns\FarmerNodes` (Anniversary / Classic Era)
3. Launch the game, and ensure the addon is enabled in your AddOns list.

---

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `/fn` or `/farmer` | Toggles the Settings Options UI window. |
| `/fn sweep` | Runs a database cleanup to merge close coordinates and remove duplicate entries. |

---

## Developer Hook API

Other addons can register callbacks to hook into the UI, inspect active pins, or dynamically change properties of pins during events.

### Callback Subscription
```lua
FarmerNodes:RegisterCallback(eventName, callbackFunc)
```

| Event Name | Parameters | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `"OnPinCreated"` | `(pinFrame, category, nodeID, mapType)` | Fired when a pin is acquired or created. `mapType` is `"minimap"` or `"worldmap"`. |
| `"OnPinReleased"` | `(pinFrame, mapType)` | Fired when a pin is recycled back to the cache pool. |
| `"OnPinUpdated"` | `(pinFrame, distSq, mapType)` | Fired during Minimap updates when a pin’s visual state is refreshed. |
| `"OnDatabaseUpdated"` | `(zoneID, category, encodedCoord, nodeID, actionType)` | Fired when a node is added (`"ADD"`) or deleted (`"DELETE"`). |

### Public Queries
* `FarmerNodes:GetActiveMinimapPins()`: Returns a key-value table of all active minimap pin frames currently rendered.
* `FarmerNodes:GetActiveWorldMapPins()`: Returns an array of all active world map pin frames.
* `FarmerNodes:GetNodesInZone(zoneID, category)`: Returns all database nodes in a given zone ID for a specific category.

# FarmerNodes

## [v1.6.4](https://github.com/malkamius/FarmerNodes/tree/v1.6.4) (2026-11-25)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/malkamius/FarmerNodes/compare/v1.6.3...v1.6.4) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/malkamius/FarmerNodes/releases)

- fix(database): add WoW Forever nodes and variants  
    Add missing WoW Forever starter-zone node variants and endgame nodes so  
    gathering them is recognized and saved to the map database while  
    preserving canonical display names.  
    - Add `FarmerNodes.NodeAliases` mapping `Poor Copper Vein` (201),  
      `Wilted Peacebloom` (401), and `Stunted Silverleaf` (402), merged  
      into `NodeIDs` after `ReverseNodeIDs` is built.  
    - Add Forever-exclusive nodes `Heavy Thorium Vein` (4201), `Demonsage`  
      (4401), and `Marefoil` (4402) with icons and skill levels matching  
      GatherMate2 IDs.  
    - Emit canonical node names in `FarmerNodes_NodeAdded`.  
    - Log `[Debug] SKIP` with `unknown_node` or `no_target` in  
      `Collector:TryResolveAndRecord` when `/fn debug` is enabled.  
    - Bump version to 1.6.4 in `FarmerNodes.toc`.

# FarmerNodes

## [v1.6.3](https://github.com/malkamius/FarmerNodes/tree/v1.6.3) (2026-11-25)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/malkamius/FarmerNodes/compare/v1.6.2...v1.6.3) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/malkamius/FarmerNodes/releases)

- fix(collector): record nodes reliably on gather  
    Fix newly gathered nodes failing to record on WoW Forever and newer  
    clients, and stop high minimap tracking radii from rejecting valid  
    nearby nodes as duplicates.  
    - Record known nodes immediately on `UNIT_SPELLCAST_SENT` with  
      fallbacks on `CURSOR_CHANGED`, `UNIT_SPELLCAST_STOP`, and  
      `UNIT_SPELLCAST_SUCCEEDED`, plus `C_Map` position fallback and  
      map-pin tooltip guards.  
    - Cache world node tooltips on `GameTooltip` `OnShow` and add  
      `/fn debug` collector diagnostic logging.  
    - Decouple duplicate-node detection in `Database:AddNodeChecked` and  
      `Database:SweepDatabase` from `profile.trackDistance` (which  
      defaults to 105 yards on WoW Forever), using 15 yards for  
      Mining/Herbalism/Treasure and 25 yards for Fishing/Gas.  
    - Bump version to 1.6.3 in `FarmerNodes.toc`.

# FarmerNodes

## [v1.6.2](https://github.com/malkamius/FarmerNodes/tree/v1.6.2) (2026-11-21)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/malkamius/FarmerNodes/commits/v1.6.2) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/malkamius/FarmerNodes/releases)

- fix(collector): guard against secret values  
    Add `issecretvalue` checks in `Collector` so protected or secret  
    spell/unit/tooltip values in newer WoW clients do not cause Lua errors  
    when tracking gathering casts.  
    - Guard `spellID`, spell name, `unit`, `target`, `castGUID`, and  
      tooltip text with `issecretvalue`.  
    - Add GitHub Actions release workflow (`.github/workflows/release.yml`)  
      and `X-Curse-Project-ID` metadata for automated CurseForge/GitHub  
      releases with markdown changelogs.  
    - Exclude `docs/` and `FarmerNodes.code-workspace` in `.curseignore`.  
    - Bump version to 1.6.2 in `FarmerNodes.toc`.  
- fix(worldmap): prevent SetPassThroughButtons combat taint  
    Blizzard's MapCanvasPinMixin:CheckMouseButtonPassthrough calls the  
    protected Frame:SetPassThroughButtons() method during combat lockdown,  
    causing ADDON\_ACTION\_BLOCKED errors when pins are acquired or refreshed.  
    - Stub CheckMouseButtonPassthrough and SetPassThroughButtons on  
      FarmerNodesWorldMapPinMixin to avoid calling the protected API.  
    - Guard WorldMapModule:OnDataChanged to only refresh when the map is  
      currently shown.  
    - Add OnShow and OnMapChanged handlers to WorldMapDataProvider so pins  
      refresh when the map is opened or changed.  
    - Bump version to 1.6.1 in FarmerNodes.toc.  
- feat(keybindings): prefix binding display names with addon name  
- feat(keybindings): group under AddOns category and add open keybindings button  
- feat: add world map opacity and Forever defaults  
    Add an opacity slider setting for world map pins and configure  
    calibrated default profile settings when playing on World of Warcraft  
    Forever (including tracking distance, pin scales, and opacities).  
- feat: add World of Warcraft Forever support  
    Add interface version 16001 for World of Warcraft Forever, upgrade  
    HereBeDragons-2.0 to minor 35 with WOW\_PROJECT\_CAMELOT map transforms,  
    upgrade AceDB-3.0 to minor 39 with RegionalUniqueNamesEnabled support,  
    upgrade LibDBIcon-1.0 to minor 50, and modernize Collector spell queries  
    using C\_Spell APIs for 11.0+/Forever compatibility.  
- chore: update interface version to support Classic Era and TBC  
    - Update Interface version to 11508, 20505 in FarmerNodes.toc  
    - Bump addon version to 1.4.3  
- chore: update interface version to 11508 for classic era and bump version to 1.4.2  
    - Update Interface version to 11508 in FarmerNodes.toc  
    - Bump addon version to 1.4.2  
- fix(minimap): isolate tracking checks per category  
    Isolate tracking active checks to their respective categories: Mining,  
    Herbs, Fishing, Gas, and Treasure. Previously, all non-Mining  
    categories defaulted to checking the Herbalism spell ID (2383), causing  
    Gas, Fishing, and Treasure nodes to display whenever Herb Gathering was  
    active even if the player lacked their specific tracking item/spell.  
    - Map Mining to 2580, Herbs to 2383, Fishing to 43308, Gas to 30645,  
      and Treasure to 2481.  
    - Add spellID checks and category-specific texture matching to both  
      C\_Minimap and fallback GetTrackingTexture paths.  
- feat(minimap): add circle opacity and smart alpha options  
    - Add Minimap Circle Opacity config option to adjust tracking circle transparency.  
    - Add Smart Circle Opacity toggle that dynamically dims circle indicators in crowded areas (nodes within 5 yards).  
    - Separate minimap pin alpha from circle indicator alpha in rendering logic.  
    - Default minimapCircleAlpha to 0.6 and minimapCircleSmartAlpha to true.  
- fix(ui): crop icon borders and fix arcane vortex  
    - Set wrap mode of circular mask to CLAMPTOBLACKADDITIVE to remove edge bleeding.  
    - Zoom-crop icons to 15% (0.15, 0.85) on both minimap and world map to hide square icon backgrounds.  
    - Fix Arcane Vortex icon texture path to INV\_Elemental\_Mote\_Mana.  
- feat(minimap): add circle color customization and fix pin alignment  
    - Allow custom tracking circle colors for each category (defaulting to red)  
    - Implement C\_Minimap.GetViewRadius() in Minimap radius calculations  
    - Add a +1.5px X/Y offset to align pins with Blizzard's yellow dots  
    - Add circular mask to all map pins to hide square black borders  
    - Fix missing gas node icons by using standard Blizzard item icons  
    - Fix World Map cluster hover radius circles and connection lines drawing  
    - Prevent Lua script error on zoning by checking for nil player position  
- feat(cluster): implement node clustering and worldmap breakout  
    Implement a robust agglomerative single-linkage clustering system to group  
    nearby nodes and reduce map clutter.  
    On the World Map, clusters are rendered dynamically:  
    - The cluster center is represented by the icon of the most frequent resource type in that cluster, with a badge showing the count of that specific resource type.  
    - Mousing over the center pin (or any of its sub-nodes) triggers a visual breakout showing each individual sub-node pin at its actual location, connected to the center by thin green lines.  
    - Mousing away hides the sub-nodes and lines after a stable 0.05-second delay to allow seamless cursor transitions.  
    - The tooltip of the cluster center pin displays detailed sorted counts of each resource type inside the cluster.  
    Performance & Persistence Optimizations:  
    - Toggling grouping on/off no longer destroys the cached cluster data, enabling instant toggle switching.  
    - Removed redundant full database cluster recalculations on player login / UI reload, dramatically reducing screen load times.  
    - Added a "Recalculate & Apply Clusters" button in the options panel so that range/separation recalculations are done only on-demand, preventing UI lag when dragging sliders.  
    On the Minimap:  
    - Added a configuration option "Disable Clustering on Minimap" (enabled by default) to keep showing raw, unclustered nodes for immediate gather visibility while keeping the World Map grouped.  
- ## New Features  
    - Added a **Node Display Mode** option in the settings (`/fn` or `/farmer`). This allows you to choose between displaying the most likely base resource (e.g. Fel Iron/Adamantite instead of Khorium), the exact harvested resource, or the highest level potential resource.  
    ## Bug Fixes  
    - Fixed a bug causing all Fel Iron and Adamantite ore nodes to display as Khorium.  
    - Fixed a lua error/crash when right-clicking map pins in WoW 11.0 / Anniversary client due to the removal of `EasyMenu`.  
    - Fixed a bug where deleting a resource node from the minimap context menu failed to specify the correct zone.  
    - Fixed missing or incorrect icons for Adamantite and Rich Adamantite nodes.  
- feat: import initial FarmerNodes codebase  
    Initialize the Git repository and import all core components of the  
    FarmerNodes addon:  
    - Core tracking engine: collector, hook APIs, and database de-duplication  
    - Display modules: MapCanvas-based World Map provider and pooled Minimap pins  
    - UI & Config: AceConfig panel, Minimap button, and integration importers
